_about: Maps problem tags used by external Go sites onto Go Magic's (phase x concept) grid. Tag names are facts about vocabularies, not copyrightable content. Compiled 2026-08-18.
_structural_finding: No external source emits a (phase, concept) PAIR. goproblems.com and OGS share an identical 7-value flat enum: elementary, life and death, joseki, fuseki, tesuji, best move, endgame. Of those, 3 give only phase, 2 give only concept, 1 is a difficulty band, 1 is null. Since tesuji + life-and-death are ~92% of those corpora, ~92% of imported problems arrive with the phase axis BLANK.
_phase_recovery: The missing phase axis is recoverable from the SGF every source ships: stone count on the board, board size (9x9/13x13 whole-board puzzles are phase-bearing), corner/side/centre contact, and whether surrounding groups are settled. That classifier is the concrete work item this mapping exposes.

coverage_from_free_sources._basis: restricted to the actually-reusable set: NDL public-domain positions, Sensei's Library under OPL, Go Game Guru's 422 under NC
coverage_from_free_sources.opening|fighting: NEAR-EMPTY - no tag on any site; early-invasion fights are almost never packaged as problems
coverage_from_free_sources.opening|tesuji: NEAR-EMPTY - tesuji is definitionally a settled local fight, which the opening does not yet have
coverage_from_free_sources.opening|life-and-death: EMPTY - by move ~15 nothing is enclosed enough to be a tsumego. Plan to author in-house
coverage_from_free_sources.opening|analysis: THIN - Sensei's 'Opening exercises' index has 5 entries; volume exists only at 101weiqi, which is not reusable
coverage_from_free_sources.opening|knowledge: REFERENCE-RICH, PUZZLE-POOR - dictionaries exist, scored puzzles do not (goproblems joseki ~0.4%)
coverage_from_free_sources.middle-game|fighting: GOOD - Gokyo Shumyo capturing races 96 + chasing 40 (PD)
coverage_from_free_sources.middle-game|tesuji: SATURATED - Gokyo Shumyo 46 + 74 (PD), Sensei's 63, plus Go Game Guru
coverage_from_free_sources.middle-game|life-and-death: SATURATED - Gokyo Shumyo 264 (PD), Igo Hatsuyoron 183 (PD), Sensei's ~940 pages
coverage_from_free_sources.middle-game|knowledge: WEAKEST OF THE MODERATE TIER - was to be filled by Shape Up!, whose licence is now unclear at source
coverage_from_free_sources.endgame|fighting: NEAR-EMPTY - no tag anywhere; only semeai-intersect-yose, which nobody curates
coverage_from_free_sources.endgame|tesuji: MODERATE in principle, THIN from clean sources - Guanzi Pu is rich here but its only transcription is unclear
coverage_from_free_sources.endgame|life-and-death: THIN BUT REAL - bent four, under the stones, seki, ten-thousand-year ko across the PD classics
coverage_from_free_sources.endgame|knowledge: THIN - endgame value tables are reference text, not problems

_headline: 2 cells saturated, 1 good, 2-3 moderate, 4 thin, 3 near-empty, 1 empty. The entire OPENING row plus endgame|fighting is where free material does not exist - which is exactly where Go Magic's hand-authored catalogue is differentiated, AND exactly the row a Glicko-2 recovery will have least attempt data for, since a gated tree serves opening nodes last.
